item.title: Sally Mauro teacher awarded this month’s ‘Apples for Teachers’ award
item.description: CARBON COUNTY — Sally Mauro Elementary’s Sarah Spear was nominated for this month’s AJB Broadcasting “Apples for Teachers” award. Spear was nominated by Tenisha Anderson, who commended her efforts to consistently go “above and beyond.” “She sees each child for who they are, meets them where they are, and believes in their potential, even on the hardest days,” Anderson stated.
